Maintain universal AGENTS.md guidance at the narrowest applicable scope through exact, approval-gated edits.

## When to use

Audit and update universal AGENTS.md guidance at the narrowest user, repository, nested, or private scope through exact approval-gated proposals.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link maintain-agent-guidance --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link maintain-agent-guidance --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Learning outcomes

- Choose the narrowest guidance scope that owns a recurring agent decision.
- Apply independently approved instruction changes without leaking private context.

## Examples

**Prompt**

**Expected outcome**

The user receives a minimal exact proposal targeted to the applicable AGENTS.md file.
